caption: The drawing depicts a highly ornamental wooden cabinet or wall box with intricate carvings and decorative elements in brown tones. At the top center of the composition, there is a sculpted head of a deer with prominent antlers. The upper portion of the cabinet features elaborate scrollwork and leaf-like patterns. The main body of the cabinet includes a single door with a three-dimensional carving of a bird, positioned as if hanging upside down. On either side of the cabinet, there are carved vertical columns, each entwined with a cord or rope design that terminates in an arrow at both the top and bottom. The lower edge of the cabinet is adorned with more scrolling and leaf-like woodwork. The overall composition focuses on symmetry and intricacy, with the object rendered in detailed, realistic shades of brown. There is a small, circular knob on the left side of the door and a visible keyhole just below it. The artist's signature, "HARRY MARK WADDELL," is located beneath the drawing.
title: Wall Cabinet, Hand Carved
